findings.title: Google tag loaded with an invalid ID (AW-Not_set)
findings.detail: gtag.js was requested for `AW-Not_set` — a tag is configured with a placeholder / unset ID, so its hits go nowhere.
findings.recommendation: Find the tag (GTM Google Tag / Ads tag or theme snippet) using this ID and set the real ID or remove it.

findings.title: Not met: GA4 sent from one source only — GTM-K6FVJ4PB
findings.detail: G-W7K2V61PS4 is configured in GTM and in the Shopify Google & YouTube app; page_view hits per page load: G-W7K2V61PS4×2. Why it matters: Double tagging inflates sessions, page views and revenue, and breaks conversion rates.
findings.recommendation: Pick one owner: disable GA4 in the Shopify app (keep Ads/Merchant Center there) or remove the GTM GA4 tags.

findings.title: Not met: GA4 — Page view sent once per load
findings.detail: Duplicates on one page load: G-W7K2V61PS4×2 (from Shopify app: Google & YouTube) Why it matters: Double page views inflate traffic and deflate conversion rates; for ad pixels they distort optimisation.
findings.recommendation: Remove the second source (app vs GTM vs hard-coded / custom pixel).

findings.title: Same GA4 property in a Shopify app pixel and GTM
findings.detail: G-W7K2V61PS4 is configured both in the Shopify Google & YouTube app and in GTM.
findings.recommendation: Keep a single source per property or events will double count.

findings.title: Needs attention: GA4 ecommerce funnel coverage — GTM-K6FVJ4PB
findings.detail: Configured in GTM: begin_checkout, purchase, remove_from_cart, select_item, view_cart, view_item, view_item_list. Missing core: add_to_cart; missing recommended: add_shipping_info, add_payment_info. Split ownership: add_to_cart is sent by Shopify Google & YouTube app, not GTM. Why it matters: Gaps or split ownership break funnel reports and double-count shared events.
findings.recommendation: Move the whole funnel to one owner (GTM or the app) and remove the other's GA4 events.

findings.title: 1 tracking script(s) held until consent
findings.detail: Parked as non-executable until the CMP grants consent: Shopify CDN (ignore).
findings.recommendation: Positive if intentional; make sure the banner is actually shown to the visitors it applies to, otherwise these tags never fire.

findings.title: No consent banner shown to this (US) visitor
findings.detail: 5 ad platform(s) fire without a banner — normal for US opt-out. Geo-targeted CMP present in the page: Anowave Cookie Consent (Shopify app). No US opt-out link (Do Not Sell / Your Privacy Choices) found.
findings.recommendation: Confirm EU/UK visitors get an opt-in banner and that the US opt-out link + GPC actually suppress ad pixels (Shopify Customer Privacy sale_of_data).

findings.title: Needs attention: Measurement ID in a variable, not hard-coded — GTM-K6FVJ4PB
findings.detail: 12 of 12 GA4 event tags hard-code the measurement ID. Why it matters: Hard-coded IDs make property migrations and staging setups error-prone.
findings.recommendation: Reference a Constant / Lookup Table variable so the ID changes in one place.

findings.title: Needs attention: No unused variables — GTM-K6FVJ4PB
findings.detail: 6 variable(s) not referenced by any tag, trigger or variable: DLV - ecommerce.payment_type, DLV - ecommerce.shipping_tier, DLV - ecommerce.aw_feed_label, DLV - ecommerce.user_data.user_id, DLV - ecommerce.enhanced_conversion_data, User-Provided Data #23 Why it matters: Clutter hides what actually drives data.

findings.title: Needs attention: Meta — Add to cart sent once per cart add
findings.detail: Sent 2× to 2466451116920362 for a single cart add. Why it matters: Double add-to-cart events inflate funnel rates and remarketing audience signals.
findings.recommendation: Find the second trigger (app + theme script, or two listeners) and keep one.

findings.title: Needs attention: Stack — Third-party request volume
findings.detail: 1131 third-party requests across the visit (20 identified platforms). Why it matters: Tag weight slows pages, which costs conversion rate.
findings.recommendation: Audit apps/pixels that don't earn their weight.
